scope: skill progression only; halt further design expansion until review

current_runtime.stars: stored 1..15 and used in stage_difficulty power proxy; absent Stats.derive
current_runtime.mastery: credited on win; P2 p2_confirm increments 1; need per-cast dedupe and trivial opponent exclusion
current_runtime.branch: B2 radius multipliers applied twice for some P2 shapes (1.15*1.05); generic area on single/support may be meaningless

skill_level.explanation: 38% base from 19 level upgrades; +12 percentage points on grade advance, net monotonic; no multiplicative compounding

grade.requires: L=20 and sufficient RES-130; no additional star/cap gate proposed
grade.pity: four consecutive failures for same ninja+skill+target grade guarantees fifth attempt

stars.proposed: natural foundation stats and level growth only multiplied by 1+0.04*(stars-1); then add allocations, training, permanent, gear; derived stats calculated once
stars.reason: avoid duplicate star effect; current +4% power proxy is not runtime stats; update power proxy to derive once

mastery.counter: confirmed meaningful casts, max once per cast_id+primary actor+skill, no subhit/summon/overheal/trivial enemy farming; commit once on legitimate win
mastery.talent: use accumulated fractional credit if talent, avoid round(1*1.08) losing bonus
mastery.unlock: retain existing 500/1500 and trial requirements; individual thresholds to verify via organic play
mastery.branch: existing grade>=3; no new mastery requirement without approval

evolution.path: 792 linear,216 branching; retain existing branch IDs; two exclusive branches; B2 geometry once only, no extra arbitrary targets; branches adapt by profile
evolution.extra: 288 additional skills via authored realm/previous skill grade/mastery/personal trial; predecessor stays available; no duplicate identity
evolution.holds: P3 holds remain; source metadata unchanged

migration.preserve: all grade/level/fails/mastery/branch/skill IDs, no debit/refund or reset; invalid data report separately
migration.compatibility: do not change runtime until user approves; compare old/new stats from same save
migration.numeric_validation: formula monotonic and coefficient total arithmetic; not Godot simulation

damage.label: Sát thương
damage.secondary: preserve hit count and geometry; allocate budget across all hits/DoT; no separate F per hit

heal.label: Trị liệu
heal.secondary: effective missing HP only; no overheal mastery

shield.label: Hộ thuẫn
shield.secondary: duration and stack rule unchanged unless branch; shield absorption capped by actual hit

control.label: Khống chế
control.secondary: control duration = min(authored effect cap, base_duration*(1+0.20*(F-1)/F)); chance unchanged; boss <= authored cap

stance.label: Cường hóa/giải thuật
stance.secondary: stat caps still apply; cleanse count unchanged; if no magnitude, use bounded resource efficiency instead

resource.label: Chakra
resource.secondary: actual missing/available chakra only; no recursive transfer; no free chakra generation

summon.label: Triệu hồi
summon.secondary: cap, lifetime, role and no recursion unchanged; heal summon scales healing instead of attack

wall.label: Tường chắn
wall.secondary: if destructible wall supported, durability coefficient * F instead of duration bonus; never add both by default

form.label: Kích hoạt hình thái
form.secondary: form stat multipliers, form duration and form cooldown unchanged; no double payment

utility.label: Dịch chuyển/đánh dấu/né/giải thuật đặc thù
utility.primary: damage if authored * F, otherwise base_CP*(1-0.15*(F-1)/F)
utility.secondary: preserve charge limits, targets, eligibility, mark count, invulnerability and teleport safe bounds
